Simple & Creative Recipes to Try at home. These are 100% vegetarian recipes which are easy, tasty and healthy. Lockdown recipes at home (Healthy and tasty) 

Buy Toxin Free Face Scrubs by Mamaearth - https://bit.ly/2W8ZtPl
(Apply discount coupon FITTUBER21 to get 21% OFF)

Due to the extension of this much needed lockdown and the risk involved in online food delivery, most of us realise that currently home cooked food is the only wise and safe option. And I firmly believe that at this time your home cooked food need not be boring. That is why, while deciding these 5 recipes my focus has been on fresh and creative dishes that you may never try at home otherwise, basic ingredients that are easily available in this situation and of course beginner friendly recipes. Trust me guys, self cooking not only makes you more conscious of what you eat but can also be more fun than watching a random episode on netflix. So, without any further delay, let’s get started.
